headline: MIA @ WSN matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is MIA 4.22 at WSN 4.37, with a projected total of 8.59. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward MIA: MIA moved +0.78 runs while WSN moved -0.07, changing the projected margin by +0.85 runs. The projected total climbed +0.70, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability rose +13.6%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: Andrew Alvarez has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 1.4 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for James Wood, Xavier Edwards, Otto Lopez, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags José Tena, Andrés Chaparro because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
